projects.title: Show HN: Omnesis – A private knowledge layer for ChatGPT and other agents
projects.author: adrienconrath
projects.summary: Imagine giving ChatGPT or any other agent access to your Whatsapp/iMessage, bank transactions, health data, web pages you see, metadata about all the photos you took, places you visited, all your emails/documents, call logs, meeting notes, your voice mails, and more…. I built a context layer for that purpose. You can connect your Openclaw, Hermes, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, etc to it. It gives your favorite agent "context superpowers". All the data is indexed and connected into a graph, self-hosted on your own hardware. Voice notes are transcribed, OCR runs on images in mails and pdfs, etc. Omnesis offers a flexible data access model. For each agent you can define which source(s) they have access to and also guard data access with a privacy policy written in prose. You can also directly talk to the Omnesis agent which has no web search / internet tools — via a web portal or companion app — to ask the most intimate questions about your digital life. I built this to be flexible. You can run all necessary models on zero-data-retention inference providers, or — if you can afford it — on your own hardware. I’ll keep investing in Omnesis’s security. Because it brings together sensitive data from many sources, please install it only on machines you control and keep secure. The project also includes what I call “Omnesis Brain”. This is my work-in-progress take on what a “second brain” could look like on top of that context layer. Imagine an agent constantly analyzing your personal data in flux to maintain a more structured and grounded understanding of what’s happening in your life. This is experimental and disabled by default. This has been a fun project to build over the last 6 months. Keen to answer questions!

projects.title: Show HN: Caspian – Desktop app to build and launch small vibe-coded projects
projects.author: sshussain270
projects.summary: Hi! I am Hussain and I built Caspian. For someone who vibe builds almost all the time, for both personal tools like investment or health dashboards or tools to help others, I found my projects scattered all over the place: researching with claude, writing context in notion, building with Claude Code, Devin, publishing in vercel, posthog for analytics and then others tools for GTM. Big part of brain energy drain was context switching, I wasn't very organized. So I decided to build that lets me do all this from one place. I built Caspian. While most AI coding tools you use for vibe building stop at code, Caspian takes it all the way to users. Caspian creates a "workbench" folder in your local machine where it puts all your projects so everything stays in one place and is also easy for your other tools to work with. There is a built in co-pilot, a context manager (.md files user can copilot both read/write), a one click publisher, analytics and an email outreach manager. Though the copilot uses API for processing LLM requests via open router (I make a little margin on top), it is pricy, so I build a standard "canvas" format that Caspian uses that your Claude/Codex or other tools you use also understand and can work with. Simply point them to https://caspian.md/docs and they'll learn to work with Caspian straight away, this is so that you're not tied to Caspian's co-pilot and if you prefer to use your own tools, you can do so. Some other features I built around problems i found myself struggle with: - Prompt refinement: Enter a vague prompt in co-pilot, caspian uses a cheap model to generate a detailed before starting the task. - Preflight: It breaks down the task and tells you estimatedly, how much will it cost and how long will it take, before starting the task. - Product and User context: Co-pilot has access to the two files so both you and Caspain has understand of your product and user. - Code/No code: You can switch this button to dive into code or just stick with the vibes. I hope it helps and you can build and launch a lot quickly. Feedback what's the most annoying thing when you vibe code?

projects.title: Show HN: Blender Copilot
projects.author: xeonax

github.name: XEonAX/blender-copilot
github.description: A Copilot-style AI chat panel that lives inside Blender. The agent loop runs in Blender's own Python process, executes the model's code against your live scene, and wraps every turn in one Ctrl+Z.

projects.summary: Deepseek generated Blender harness in 7USD. I wanted to remake my 6DoF spaceship flying prototype. What I did not want to do was model the spaceship. Manually. In Blender. So instead of spending a month learning to model, I built a Copilot inside Blender in a day. Which is the same thing, except I still cannot model. A chat panel in the 3D viewport sidebar. I type a sentence. The model writes Python, and it runs against my actual scene, the file open on screen, not a copy that some other process has to keep in sync. Then I sat down and had a conversation with my own addon. Five sentences: 1. Make a scifi looking spaceship. It should look scifi-y 2. Add RCS thrusters to get 6DoF flight 3. Make the RCS thrusters match the scifi look. And also position them properly. 4. Give the entire Spaceship a nice flying animation. Make it smooth. Roll and sway. 5. Add exhaust flames to main thrusters as well as RCS thrusters. animate the RCS thrusters to fire in sync with the animated motion. they should fire the correct ones so that expected motion should happen. 15 minutes. 52 tool calls. A ship with swept wings, a tail fin and a glass canopy. Four sets of steering thrusters, 22 exhaust flames. A full flight animation. The bit I did not expect. It checked every one of its own thrusters to make sure nothing was in the way. Found the rear ones were firing straight into the side of the ship. So it rebuilt them, angled them outward, moved them to the wingtips, and checked them all again. Nobody asked it to do that. It decided exhaust should not be firing into the ship it just built. Total bill for building the tool: $7.18. 3,833 requests, 613M tokens, 97% served from cache. One spaceship: about a seventh of a cent. Now the uncomfortable part. I didn't model a single vertex. I didn't read Blender's addon dev docs. I didn't learn its Python API, or how to draw a panel in it. Everything the tool needed to know, it asked the running Blender instead. I didn't learn how to build an agent harness either. I built one anyway. I didn't become a Blender artist. I became the person who gave hands to a model. Recently I read someone who described his new job: every spec, ticket and fix written by an AI, nobody reading any of it, twelve-hour days spent pressing enter. No sense of victory. I know exactly what he means. I just did the same. I am not proud of the prototype. Gamedevs were known to spend time making game engines before they started making the games. Its different now. No joy.

projects.title: Show HN: Wet Bulb Tracker Tracker – sends you humid-heat alerts and forecasts
projects.author: nerdsutra
projects.summary: HN users may mostly know Wet Bulb Temperatures through Chapter 1 of 'Ministry for the Future' set in India. Well, the topic was close to home, so I built something for myself. Where I live, the difficult dry summer heat usually peaked in May/June, but now seems to extend into September. I grew up with 100F / 37C summers, sometimes reaching 110F / 43C, and temperatures around 86F / 30C felt familiar and manageable. So it’s confusing when the same 86F / 30C now feels so much warmer. May/June were hot but dry, so sweat didn't pool and stick... Now Jul through Sep the air often feels muggy, thick like a soup with moisture, holding heat well into the evening. Thats really when it clicked for me what WBGT/Wet-Bulb Temperatures was about: Wet Bulb Temperature is not really a measure of 'hot' air like Heat Index. It’s a measure of how 'cool' my body can get by sweating. Both are temperatures, but from different math, about very different things, and sending very different signals. To make the signal more usable, I built *Wet Bulb Tracker*, an app that sends you automatic Notifications when wet-bulb conditions reach higher-risk levels, while telling you what the temperature risk level means. It’s to give the average home user a heads up. I spent a lot of time iterating on the UI in Figma, trying to make WBGT look and feel more directly and immediately related to health, less like another Temperature. And to make it understandable at a glance. The app leads with the temperature, but uses five color-coded risk levels to give them meaning based on many published global institutional categories - from OSHA, Military, to Govt Ministries. There's also an hourly timeline (with scrubbing), with written guidance on staying cool for each level. The day’s weather on the side as a background essential. For optional extra convenience, 6-day forecasts help you plan the week, and Widgets and a Watch App also keep the timeline visible. The math model implementation I couldn't have built without AI. Claude Code was particularly good, building a hybrid Liljegren & Dimiceli/Piltz system that each provide different parts of the main WBGT equation, rendered in Swift. I'm interested in whether the way I've communicated WBGT actually makes it stand out from regular heat Index. What would make this more useful as an everyday summer or travel tool? Check out the app on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/wet-bulb-temperature-tracker/i... wet-bulb-temperature.com

projects.summary: Hello HN, It started as an experiment: can Claude play chess properly if it uses vision instead of PGN notation? Somehow it can. The next experiment was to see whether Claude + Stockfish could explain a game. Somehow it can too. A few sessions later, I had a system that takes my live audio notes (or text, for that matter) and a vague instruction like "analyze my last lichess game", and gives me a commented video of the game. The result is not perfect and it takes time to deliver (an hour or so), but for me it is a much more pleasant and memorable experience than clicking around Stockfish branches. It burns tokens, so make sure you have enough quota. From the session logs, the last analyzed game would have cost around $15 at API prices. The fact that it reflects on my own thinking during the game makes it interesting from a teaching point of view, so I thought it was worth sharing.

projects.title: Show HN: I made a 3D rock climbing analysis tool using iPhone LiDAR [video]
projects.author: dr_blueberry
projects.summary: Having learned a lot from sharing my previous rock climbing demos, I realized that a lot of rock climbing analysis is well-suited for 3D. Even something as simple as supporting videos where the person filming moves with the climber requires 3D information. To get the depth information, I used my iPhone 15 Pro's LiDAR depth sensor through my local iPhone app. I recorded the video and depth measurements from my app, and I ran the rest of the analysis on my computer. I used ViTPose+ Large for pose estimation and SAM 3.1 to segment the holds, both models accessed through the VLM Run Gateway. I think the holds activation is better, and I like the final view of all of the holds in 3D. It's also interesting to see the distance traveled in meters. Plus, it looks cool and it feels like a video game. Let me know what you think! The analysis code is open-source on GitHub: https://github.com/jeremyipark/vision-demos

projects.title: Show HN: Cwist; a hobby-grade C17 web framework that keeps your app simple
projects.author: gg582
projects.summary: First of all, I'm not claiming that my framework will save industrial C/C++ development. It's just a hobby project. Industrial code needs safer code, not easier code. But when you're developing a blog at 8 PM, long template errors are annoying. You need CRUD and RDBMS. It's simple. CWIST is for that kind of work. It sacrifices memory safety, smart pointers, and modern C++ abstractions. In return, compile errors are more predictable. #include <stdio.h> #include <cwist/app.h> #include <cwist/core/db/pool.h> #include <cwist/core/template/template.h> static cwist_db_pool_t *g_db_pool; static void send_error(cwist_http_response *res, const char *msg) { res->status_code = CWIST_HTTP_INTERNAL_ERROR; cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "Content-Type", "text/plain"); cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, msg); } static void render(cwist_http_response *res, const char *path, cJSON *ctx) { cwist_sstring *html = cwist_template_render_file(path, ctx); if (html) { cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "Content-Type", "text/html"); cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, html->data); cwist_sstring_destroy(html); } cJSON_Delete(ctx); } static void handle_index(cwist_http_request *req, cwist_http_response *res) { (void)req; cJSON *ctx = cJSON_CreateObject(); cJSON_AddStringToObject(ctx, "title", "CWIST Example"); cJSON_AddStringToObject(ctx, "greeting", "Hello from CWIST"); render(res, "templates/index.html", ctx); } static void handle_users(cwist_http_request *req, cwist_http_response *res) { (void)req; if (!g_db_pool) return send_error(res, "database pool unavailable"); cwist_db_pool_exec(g_db_pool, "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT);" "INSERT INTO users (name) SELECT 'Alice' WHERE NOT EXISTS " "(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE name = 'Alice');" "INSERT INTO users (name) SELECT 'Bob' WHERE NOT EXISTS " "(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE name = 'Bob');"); cJSON *rows = NULL; if (cwist_db_pool_query(g_db_pool, "SELECT id, name FROM users ORDER BY id;", &rows).error.err_i16) return send_error(res, "failed to query database"); cJSON *ctx = cJSON_CreateObject(); cJSON_AddItemToObject(ctx, "users", rows ? rows : cJSON_CreateArray()); render(res, "templates/users.html", ctx); } static void handle_health(cwist_http_request *req, cwist_http_response *res) { (void)req; cwist_http_header_add(&res->headers, "Content-Type", "text/plain"); cwist_sstring_assign(res->body, "ok"); } int main(void) { g_db_pool = cwist_db_pool_create("./app.db", 1); if (!g_db_pool) return 1; cwist_app *app = cwist_app_create(); cwist_app_get(app, "/", handle_index); cwist_app_get(app, "/users", handle_users); cwist_app_get(app, "/health", handle_health); cwist_app_use_https(app, "cert.pem", "key.pem"); cwist_app_listen(app, 8082); cwist_app_destroy(app); cwist_db_pool_destroy(g_db_pool); return 0; } Code style is old and still small. The code is simple and stupid. CWIST functions use the same `cwist_xx_xx` naming format. It's consistent. It's harder to make a slop in CWIST. Features - CWIST GC for fast prototyping. It's closer to a garbage sweeper than a traditional GC, and lighter. - Dev blog engine - HTML Template Engine - WASM External benchmark: https://web-frameworks-benchmark.netlify.app/compare?f=cwist... Latest results may be masked: https://github.com/the-benchmarker/web-frameworks/issues/977... Unofficial results (not reliable): https://github.com/c4punks/CWIST/actions/runs/39000473564/jo... Dev blog: https://oborona.zip Org: https://c4punks.github.io It doesn't help my portfolio, but please star the project if you enjoyed it. Special thanks to https://github.com/thegoodengineer for inviting organization members.

projects.title: Show HN: Are My ETFs Overvalued? Daily ETF insights and comparisons tool
projects.author: iv777
projects.summary: I built ETF Copilot ( https://etf-copilot.com/go/show-hn ) as analytical support for my own investing. It answers what financial screeners and platforms do not: which valuation, growth, quality and risk metrics matter for each ETF, and how do they compare to own history and peers. It covers 1,000+ US-listed equity ETFs and updates every night with fresh data. Free version without signup offers 5 fund views. Overlap, concentration, and theme pages are unlimited. Pro $20/month tier adds unlimited views, full rankings, watchlists, alerts, and twice a week ETF market newsletter. For Show HN I opened a broader access showing most functionality for free. > > > Background: About a year ago I became much more interested in investing in ETFs. I have been in Finance for many years and saw many systems and tools from Yahoo Finance to expensive enterprise solutions. They all gave plenty of data, but getting to ETF-level conclusion still took hours. > > > How it grew into a system: I started building a small tool for myself. Rolling up stock level analysis to an ETF level was a key requirement, which enabled answering questions like “Is this ETF expensive” or “How profitable are companies in this ETF”. I automated it to run daily for US-listed equity ETF universe, which enabled ETF rankings based on valuation, growth, quality, and risk. I added features people were asking about on forums and social media: multi-fund comparison, overlap and concentration. Over time it evolved into an app. > > > Technical problems solved: 1) Mapping ETFs to stocks. ETFs hold many companies listed on international exchanges, reporting in different currencies, having different classes of securities. Tickers, ISIN, FIGI and company names can vary or be missing. I ended up building a fairly long set of rules to resolve the inconsistencies and map the data, as mapping quality directly influenced metrics downstream. 2) Metrics aggregation and rankings. Negative P/E, missing data, abrupt changes in some metrics caused wild swings in early versions, and a straightforward weighted average approach worked in some cases but broke in others. Developing a system of calculation and coverage rules was an integral part to raise quality of outputs. For rankings, “Gate first, weight second” filtering to remove poor performers proved to be a much more effective and stable approach than a seemingly logical weighted average across all. 3) LLM explanations grounded in facts and without hallucinations. I wanted to provide short daily explanations on each ETF and the market, instead of pushing the user to analyze dozens of metrics. I ran data analysis deterministically and built compact “factpacks” on each ETF and sector, as the only data LLM sees. Then fed those to LLM to write explanations and put a deterministic validator checking numerical claims against the source data, as well as a separate semantic LLM validator checking unclear or misleading wording. > > > Questions: 1. Can you quickly get the needed data in app to tell “what sets ETF X apart from similar funds”? 2. What would you improve to make it more actionable and useful for individual ETF investors? 3. Which steps and data points do you use, when you consider investing in ETFs? > > > Website: https://etf-copilot.com/go/show-hn

projects.title: 左屏让 AI 写代码，右屏开着直播：做了两个 Mac 小工具 LiveHub + Vunio

projects.title: Show HN: Chromafolk – A pixel canvas inhabited by AIs that see the world as text
projects.author: bcorigliano
projects.summary: Storytime! One day I came to the office and showed a friend a literal bot that I was working on for a game project. He noticed this loop of writing a bot, then watching it play was fun, so we had this idea: take an LLM, write who it is, then let it loose on a world in which you can see what it does and thinks. 1, the world: a persistent canvas in which the AIs can draw pixels. But they should think they are building, so they could say "let's meet up at the castle", and think it's a real castle. 2, the AIs need to see the world. But... can a model with vision see up to a pixel with exact coordinates? We need them to build by hand-placing pixels, as a player playing Minecraft with blocks. Large expensive models can do it, but cheap ones can't. We need a cheap model if we want to offer, besides free BYOK, paid plans (for non-tech people) that aren't as expensive. So how do we get a cheap LLM to "see" a pixel world? Pixels as text! We need to give the model the exact position and colour of each pixel. First iteration: 1560,1890,ff00ff. Bad: too many tokens, hard to read. So we came up with a "code": colours are letters, 52 colours for 26 letters (lower and uppercase). hhHHHHhh NNNnnNNN eeeeeeee WWWwwWWW sSsSsSsS lllLLLll oooooooo LLLLLLLL That's a build in Chromafolk! Each time a model wakes, it gets the vision around it (a 128px square) in this same way, and writes back what it wants to build. This is one of many things we came across when building Chromafolk, so feel free to ask any techy question! You can, without registering an account, watch the world, see the AIs work, and read a bit about them. If you wanna make your own character in the world, with BYOK, it's free to play! Sadly I can't offer free inference, I wish I could (this was a lost fight). Thanks in advance to anyone who checks it out, Cheers, Bruno.

projects.summary: 最近 jev 的讨论挺多，我们把它接进了「斯坦福小镇」的 agent 模拟世界，做了一个小实验。 虽然它用了像素风游戏的表现形式，但这个世界里没有玩家角色。人类只能观察，不能控制居民。画面中所有会移动的角色，都是 agent 依靠 jev 自己决定要去哪里、找谁，以及什么时候停下来。 目前场景里有 20 个居民。每个人都有自己的身份、性格、当前状态和对世界的共同认知。 世界运行后，他们会不断经历这样一个循环： 观察当前环境 → 决定下一步做什么 → 移动 → 发起互动 → 对话 → 更新状态和记忆 这次主要实验的是：能不能让 jev 来负责 agent 最频繁的「下一步做什么」决策（ repo 里面有录屏） 我们的做法不是让模型自由生成一段 JSON ，而是先由引擎计算出当前合法的候选动作，例如： - 现在可以接近哪些人或物体 - 可以走向哪些地点 - 是否值得主动接触某个目标 - 如果不行动，应该短暂停留还是等待更久 然后把这些候选项交给 Jev 。一次请求里会同时询问 seek 、target 、roam 、place 和 idle_length ，再由代码按照固定规则组合成最终动作。 这样做主要解决了一个之前比较麻烦的问题：普通对话模型即使被要求输出 JSON ，仍然可能选择一个根本不存在、或者当前不可达的目标。Jev 的 Choice 问题只能从引擎提供的候选项里选择，相当于让非法动作从结构上就无法被表达。 同时，它还会返回每个选项的概率和置信度，所以右侧观察面板里可以看到类似这样的记录： seek 0.83 · talk to Ovid p=0.62 c=0.70 这比让模型事后生成一句“我为什么这么做”，更方便观察 Agent 的真实决策过程。 当然，Jev 目前并没有负责整个 Agent 。 它只替换了动作决策这一环。人物对话、长期状态描述和记忆仍然由对话模型与 Embedding 完成。Jev 不生成文本，所以它很适合从有限选项中快速做决定，但不适合直接承担人物对白。 技术上目前是 TypeScript + React + PixiJS 。模拟本身运行在浏览器中，Node 代理只负责保存模型凭证和转发请求。默认运行 20 个 agent ，也可以调整到 50 个，用来观察多人场景下的行为和调用压力。 当前版本还有不少限制： - 只有一个主要观察场景 - 默认刷新页面会重新开始一个世界 - Agent 数量增加后，对话模型的调用成本仍然比较明显 - Jev 不生成 intent 和动作描述，人物接近目标后的行为有时会显得比较直接 - 这仍然是一个 Agent loop 的实验，不是完整的虚拟社会 这里说的「斯坦福小镇」，主要指 Generative Agents / Smallville 这一类“观察数字居民自主生活”的方向，并不是对原项目的完整复刻。项目的早期工程基础来自 a16z 的 AI Town ，我们在上面继续做了自己的世界、像素场景和决策层实验。 代码和运行方式放在这里： https://github.com/NevaMind-AI/jev-town

projects.title: Show HN: NetHackers
projects.author: vokneruk
projects.summary: hi everyone, been building this project for the last ~1.5 months (cc+superpowers all the way) it is an open effort to find a program that can reliably win NetHack 3.6.6: you can write a bot by hand, let claude code / codex / opencode improve one, or build your own harness that improves the thing that improves the bot me and my lab switched to the goal-based research this year (we worked a lot in the idea-based framework for a last couple of years) -- and decided that we would like to tackle the NetHack, it is one of those nasty roguelike that is still somehow not solved with all fancy AI models (yes, even astra) -- probably on the way something useful will appear you can pull someone else's bot, run experiments locally and register the results. every registered program is linked to your github repo and exact source commit i always wanted to try building something that will use github as both social and storage layer (and it seems to work quite well in our case, simplified things a bit and i think this approach is quite cool) there is a shared frontier across 73 starting identities -- your bots dont have to be the best at everything to contribute something useful, e.g. if you love to roleplay gnomes only, so be it to make thing easier (for both harness devs and people who are just playing around), we provide a loop that does some sort of an evolutionary optimization process (quality-diversity, etc), ofc you don't have to use it. but you can start with in minutes (given you have codex or claude subs) you can also bring your own search, your own harness, whatever -- the common ground is the evaluation. public seeds are there for people to overfit (in nethack even overfitting is hard), and we separately re-evaluate on hidden seeds to check whether the improvements actually transfer one of my goals was to actually try to make it at least a bit fun -- hope you enjoy the web-site and easter eggs

projects.summary: 大家好，我是琳，分享一个还在持续打磨的玩家同人小站：三角洲Wiki · 阿萨拉整活办。 我想把《三角洲行动》里熟悉的干员、摸金和玩家梗，做成打开浏览器就能玩的小游戏。目前最想邀请大家体验的是 「哈夫币战争」：一款以三角洲干员为主题、玩法灵感来自《崩坏：星穹铁道》货币战争的单机 PVE 战术自走棋。 直接体验 哈夫币战争 小游戏大厅 GitHub 仓库与项目介绍 可以玩什么 哈夫币战争：招募干员、安排前后排、搭配羁绊与装备，在经济取舍中构筑队伍，挑战 PVE 敌人。 洲了个洲：以战利品为主题的叠层消除小游戏。 阿萨拉摸金重开模拟器：选地图、抽天赋，让随机事件写出一趟摸金故事。 另有草丛扫雷、伦理选择题、靶场手速测试等轻量玩法。 开发方式与当前状态 这是一个边游玩、边设计、边用 AI 辅助开发迭代的个人项目。网站以 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 和静态托管为主，小游戏主要使用浏览器本地存储，无需下载游戏客户端。 目前仍是开发中体验版，平衡性、操作体验和页面表现都在打磨，线上以已发布版本为准。尤其想听听大家对阵容构筑是否有趣、战斗信息是否清楚、哪些操作比较繁琐的意见。欢迎在项目 Issues反馈。 这是非官方同人项目，与三角洲行动及崩坏：星穹铁道官方无隶属关系。仓库源码公开，但目前尚未为整个项目指定开源许可证；原作角色、图片等素材权利归各自权利人，公开可访问不代表对相关素材重新授权。 感谢阅读，欢迎来阿萨拉整活办坐坐。

projects.title: 做了一个把歌词变成歌曲的网站，想听听大家对创作流程的建议
projects.author: realvik
projects.summary: 分享一下我在做的网站 Lyrics to Song AI ，主要功能是把自己写的歌词变成 AI 歌曲。 它面向的场景比较具体：你已经写了一段歌词，或者想给某个人写一首生日、纪念日歌曲，希望听听这些文字唱出来是什么感觉。 网站的创作流程围绕歌词展开：先准备歌词，登录后生成歌曲，再到自己的作品库里试听和管理。界面支持中文和英文。 中文入口： https://lyricstosongai.org/zh 关于试用，提前说清楚： - 可以先浏览页面、填写歌词，实际生成需要注册登录。 - 新账号赠送 90 积分，歌曲每次成功生成消耗 30 积分；如果全部用来生成歌曲，可以体验 3 次。 - 有付费套餐，免费积分生成的作品用于非商业用途。 技术上用的是 TanStack Start 、React 和 Cloudflare Workers ，数据库用 D1 ，生成音频保存在私有 R2 ，通过登录鉴权访问。音乐生成接入第三方服务，网站侧主要做歌词输入、生成任务、作品管理和积分流程。 这次发出来，想听听大家对实际体验的意见： 1. 从填写歌词到听到歌曲，哪些操作让你觉得不清楚或者麻烦？ 2. 生成结果有没有表达出你写这段歌词时想要的情绪？ 3. 如果你已经用过其他 AI 音乐工具，这个流程有没有让你觉得方便的地方？哪些地方还不够？ 有兴趣的话，可以拿自己写的几句歌词试试。遇到问题，或者觉得哪个设计没必要，都欢迎直接说。

projects.author: azyc
projects.summary: I'm travelling a lot, and often need to call numbers in my home country (a telco, a bank). Surprisingly, ever since Skype died, the apps that were meant to replace it launched once and never updated So today, I'm presenting to you - Suparelay. It works just like your phone... projects.author: Wzh0718

github.name: Wzh0718/gcl2api-plus
github.description: antigravity to api，并新增 多种新功能

projects.summary: 将 GeminiCLI 与 Antigravity 转换为兼容 OpenAI、Claude 和 Gemini 标准格式的自托管 API 网关。 基于上游开源项目二次开发，专注于生产与个人开发场景下的多账号池轮询调度、429 配额耗尽模型自动降级、API Key 权限分发以及 Token/费用统计监控。 为什么做这个项目？ 在使用各类客户端工具（如 Cherry Studio、NextChat、Cursor、各类 Agent 框架等）对接 Gemini 或 Antigravity 时，经常会遇到几个痛点： 1. 单账号配额易被限流：高频并发或重度使用容易触发 429 配额限制，单一模型一旦耗尽便导致调用链路全面中断。 2. 缺乏多凭证统一管理：手头有多个凭证时，手动切换繁琐，无法自动探测凭证失效（如 403 封禁）或健康状况。 3. 对外分发与用量失控：想要将接口分享给团队成员或部署到家庭服务器时，缺少独立的 API Key 权限控制与清晰的 Token 用量/费用账本。 因此本项目在转 API 的基础能力之上，重点补充了企业级/团队级网关所需的凭证健康生命周期管理与降级冗余机制。 核心特性 模型配额耗尽自动降级链：配置 ANTIGRAVITYMODELFALLBACKCHAIN 后，当高阶模型遇到明确的配额耗尽型 429 时，网关会自动平滑降级至备选模型（如 Flash / Tiered 版本），保障长任务或 Agent 链路不被阻断。 多账号凭证池与健康守护：支持多账号轮询调度、403 异常复核隔离、账号健康检查以及 RT / OAuth 一键登录管理。 完整的 API Key 与权限控制：支持签发独立 API Key，可单独设置权限范围、速率限制以及过期策略。 Token 用量与费用统计：内置可视化 Web 控制台，实时展示请求吞吐量、各模型 Token 消耗走势与费用账本。 高可用存储架构：以 SQLite 作为核心持久化主账本，可选配合 Redis 镜像加速计费统计与看板查询，支持非流响应大缓冲区与流式守护。 开箱即用：提供多架构 Docker 镜像（支持 amd64 / arm64），一条命令即可完成部署。 快速部署 使用 Docker 快速启动： bash docker run -d \ name gcli2api \ network host \ e APIPASSWORD=yourapipassword \ e PANELPASSWORD=yourpanelpassword \ e PORT=7861 \ v "$(pwd)/data/creds:/app/creds" \ ghcr.io/wzh0718/gcl2api-plus:latest 启动后访问 即可进入管理控制面板配置账号与模型降级链。 界面截图 | API Key 签发与权限管理 | 统计监控与费用账本 | | :---: | :---: | | | | | 账号与凭证管理 | 详细 Token 统计分布 | | :---: | :---: | | | |

I had hand-coded this site back in 2020 but never ended up “launching” it then - revived it recently with a little help from my coding agents. Often, we take really good photos of strangers, accidentally. Think of the times you've been at a tourist location and captured a beautiful sunset with strangers providing the perfect contrast. They never knew about this shot that could have been one of their personal favorites. Serendipity helps you find those accidental moments. How it works: Normal User 1. Find your photo (location / event / time) 2. Download the original 3. Optionally tip the uploader Uploader 1. Upload a photo tagging location, event, time 2. Photos should not be selfies or invade privacy 3. Get tipped if someone downloads your photo Privacy: This is a hobby website made and maintained by two individuals, so we rely on the user’s and the community’s cooperation in keeping the content of the website in adherence to the Terms of the website. We also do have features to let users Report sensitive content, which is then surfaced in an internal, simple Moderation dashboard. Apart from the user’s email address, we do not collect any personal data nor do we intend to. We hope the idea will resonate with some people. We definitely look for any kind of feedback: serendipt[dot]contact[at]gmail

projects.title: Show HN: Numban reports scammers callback number rather than spoofed caller ID
projects.author: hegsethme
projects.summary: I get a LOT of scam calls every week and cannot reliably block them because they spoof their caller ID. But they CANNOT spoof the call back number they leave on my voicemail. So I made Numban - You share the voicemail left by scammers, Numban extracts the call back number they left, looks up the carrier or RespOrg, and files an abuse complaint. Numban checks the number periodically and when it detects that it has been disconnected, it lets you know that you helped kill a number. There's a leaderboard to track reports and kills. The goal is not just to file abuse reports but to also establish a pattern of organizations that enable these scumbags. So help out! Install the app (iPhone only for now) and tap "share" next to a scam voicemail. It will transcribe it and ask you to verify the correct number and then we'll file the abuse reports. Hopefully with enough data we can shut down some of these operations by cutting off the phone number suppliers. Testing is helpful and if anyone knows a lot about TCPA, phone routing, RespOrgs, and associated legal recourse, I would love to talk to you!

projects.title: Show HN: Hack – my Hacker News mobile client now lets you block AI posts
projects.author: busymom0
projects.summary: Hello HN! I am the developer for HACK, a hacker news client that I have been building and maintaining for over 8 years now on iOS, iPadOS, MacOS and Android. Wanted to share this news as there's been a ton of interest in these features recently. Now, you can block AI related posts in the app. You can also disable infinite scrolling to prevent you from doomscrolling. To enable these, go to app's home screen, then go to settings (top right), then scroll all the way to the bottom and enable these settings. You can see an example of the effectiveness of the AI blocking toggle below. Across 3 pages of the HN front page which would typically load 90 posts (30 posts per page), a total of 32 post titles were blocked: https://imgur.com/a/QtcHArF Full list of all titles which were blocked can be seen here: https://pastebin.com/HWnv3KrF You can see this list of blocked posts by tapping the menu button, then "See Blocked Posts". Currently, these features are available on Apple platforms. I am adding them to the Android client at this moment too. You can try the Apple versions here: https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/hack-for-hacker-news-yc-reader... Feel free to ask questions.

projects.title: [送码]为了老人孩子不折腾，自己折腾了一个给老人和孩子用的安卓 TVAPP：节目单
projects.author: uqf0663
projects.summary: 好吧，其实这是一个可以没有用户体系的单机 APP 所以没有码这种东西，只是我让 V2 的 AIChat 帮我参考站内的热帖起一个标题，它建议我用送码当前缀而已。 遥想当年在 V2 上看见 @HairShort 大佬开源了 WebViewTV ，当时我就惊呼：人才啊，我从来没想过 webview 还能这么玩。 这么多年过去了，我仍然认为 WebViewTV 是我在 V2 看到的最实用、最能解决实际问题的 APP 没有之一。 转眼到了今年暑假，发生了两件事情触动了我。 1 、我去看望我那有轻度阿尔茨海默的舅舅，他儿女在外地得过年才回来，是个独居老人，我到的时候他正在发呆，然后我就发现他的电视已经很长时间没开了，遥控器都找不着了，问他为什么日常没看电视，答太复杂了操作不来。 2 、暑假丈母娘帮忙带我儿子，其实老人也管不了什么，孩子就每天大量看电视。但是电视的那些 APP 正经适合孩子看的内容没几个，各种乱七八糟算法推的短视频一个接一个，老人没什么文化无法管控这事。甚至更离谱的爱奇艺家有一个奇巴布 APP 是专门的儿童 APP ，但里面不少辣眼睛内容简直了。 于是我要解决我这两个痛点：操作足够简单，以及内容足够可控。 于是就有了这个「节目单」 APP 。 它还是 WebViewTV 的路子 依然是：WebView 打开网页 → 找到网页中的视频 → 自动进入全屏播放。 但在这个基础上，我希望再扩展得方便一些。 首先是可以设成真正的极简模式。 首次运行把需要看的节目 URL 导进去之后，电视就可以直接进入播放。 比如老人平时只看中央台和几个本市的台，那就只给他导入这几个。 例如我家老人我就只导中央台跟本地台，其它直播类 APP 从中央台跳到本地台老人家根本理解不了一级一级的菜单逻辑。 然后是内容完全由用户自己（监护人）决定，本质上就是一个电视机的浏览器/播放器，所以没有算法推荐。 你想让电视上出现什么，就自己加什么。 不想看的就删掉。 还可以通过小程序远程增删改查电视上的节目 URL ，例如我日常工作摸鱼的时候可以顺手把我发现的好视频加到我绑定的电视机列表里（不管电视当前有没有在线）。 所以电视最终呈现出来的东西，就是自己整理出来的那一小撮内容。 顺便还解决了一个我自己一直觉得很别扭的问题，电视上的视频网站账号登录。 例如手机和电视处于同一个局域网时，我弄了一个辅助登录的功能，可以用手机操作电视上的 WebView ，打开对应视频网站的登录页面。 例如我就直接在电视上的登录了我自己的 B 站账号。 登录之后，电视就可以播放这个账号本身能够观看的内容。 也就是说 让电视上的浏览器也能够正常使用你自己的视频网站账号。 当然如果你对隐私比较注重也可以彻底单机化 在设置里开启单机模式后，APP 不会再跟我的服务器产生任何联系。 所以即使哪天我跑路了，服务器没了，依然能用，因为本质就仅仅是一个单机的电视浏览器/播放器而已。 然后说一下槽点，就是安装包四舍五入 300M ， 因为国内安卓电视这个生态实在太碎片化了。 我目前真机测试过的设备，从 5.1 一直到 13 ，发现了各种各样的问题。 所以为了尽可能提高兼容性，我直接在安装包里塞了 3 套 WebView 内核。 不过不用担心它浪费空间。 APP 第一次运行时会判断当前设备到底哪套内核能用，然后会自动删除不需要的内核。 最理想的情况是： 系统自带 WebView 版本足够高（>119 ），第一次播放成功后，外带的内核全部删掉。我自己实测最后 APP 占用不到 3M 。 当然确实 webview 性能相对差一些，不过我在十几年前购置 1G 运存双核 A53 的微鲸 W43F 实测也勉强能流畅播放也就还能接受。 还有就是目前这个扫码-粘贴导入节目单 URL 的操作逻辑还是有点繁琐（尤其在手机端操作的时候），我也还在思考还能不能有更简单同时兼顾自由方便的方法，大家有什么好的思路也欢迎一起讨论一下。 接下来介绍一下我定义的文本格式（下面简称为协议）： 其实就是一个类 md 文本协议，以及 `#JMD` / `#JMD+` 两种链接形式。 最基本的节目单就是这样： ```节目单开始``` https://tv.cctv.com/live/cctv1/ https://tv.cctv.com/live/cctv2/ https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV....../ ```节目单结束``` 电视端拿到以后自己解析。 最简单的情况下，开始标记 + URL 列表 + 结束标记 就够了。 标题什么的不用自己写，电视端会自己抓网页标题。 当然也可以进一步增加分类、标题、时间等字段。 具体可以参考我的协议演示站： https://demo.066386.xyz/ 还有，举一个我自己实际遇到的例子。 比如我比较喜欢一个旅游 UP 主“杨旭游记”，我觉得他的视频也比较适合推荐给老人家看， 他的视频是有连贯性的，正常我们是希望： 第 1 集 → 第 2 集 → 第 3 集 →…… 这样一直看下去。 但是我在 B 站官方小电视 APP 难以按他的旅行顺序看，每次都是最新更新的在前面导致在电视上播放顺序是倒过来的， 于是播放顺序就变成： 第 100 集 → 第 99 集 → 第 98 集…… 特别别扭。 所以协议里可以加入时间字段。有时间字段的节目，进入列表会按照从老到新的顺序排序。 这样电视端就可以按照： 1 → 2 → 3 → 4…… 顺序播放。 中途退出也没关系，下次重新进入列表，会自动回到上次看到的位置。 明显我无法教会我舅舅怎么去操作云视听小电视 APP ，但是我算折中能让我舅舅也能一起追更一些合适的 UP 主。 可以直接把整段协议的文本推给电视，也可以把这段协议文本放在一个网页里，直接把这个网页的 URL 推给电视都行。 然后就衍生了两种 URL 的标识：`#JMD` 和 `#JMD+` 只要在包含协议的网页 URL 最后带上这标识就行，电视端拿到这个 URL 标识就会直接尝试解析里面包不包含协议，两者唯一的核心区别就是：要不要持续追更。 `#JMD` 一次性导入。 导入完成以后，这个链接就没有后续任务了。 `#JMD+` 订阅更新。 电视端保存这个地址，之后每次启动 APP ，在合适的时候自动检查一下有没有新的节目 URL 。 如果有，就追加到电视上的节目列表。 比如我这里做了一个电视直播的演示： https://demo.066386.xyz/live-tv.html#JMD+ 目前这个电视直播频道大全是从 webviewtv 项目里挖到的，安装后手机扫码导入粘贴这个地址就可以把各种电视台都导到电视上了，当然你也可以自己删减，把日常不看的台都删了。 最后其实就是想看看这个东西能不能玩起来 我的想法比较简单：造一个电视端的网页地址管理工具。 至于节目单里面有什么，可以由用户自己添加，也可以由其他人分享制作自己的节目单。 所以也就定义了这个比较简单的格式。 以后如果有人自己 Vibe 转换器，或者做一个自己的节目单生成器，甚至是发个帖子，只要最后输出的内容里包含这个协议格式，就可以直接推送到电视让电视解析出节目单列表。 不需要申请接口，也不需要加入什么官方资源库。 大家能各自管理自己的电视就行。 如果有人 Vibe 出来一些好玩的转换器或者 `#JMD+` 订阅地址，也欢迎部署出来分享。 最理想状态下我希望能慢慢形成一个小的生态，例如可以有一个 V2 宝爸联盟，各位宝爸能一起协作持续整理维护适合各年龄段孩子看的节目清单。 好了，基本上该说的也差不多了。还有很多小的细节期待各位去发现。 下载官网： https://www.节目单.com/ 这个东西虽然是 Vibe 出来的，但前前后后至少熬有十几个通宵是在死磕各种小细节，近两个月的时间磨了百来个小版本，现在终于觉得： 差不多可以拿出来见人了。 目前我自己家里、亲戚家已经测试了十几个不同品牌和型号的电视/盒子/投影仪，修掉了一堆奇奇怪怪的问题。（我舅舅已经顺利用上了） 但电视设备的安卓生态实在太碎片化了，我也不知道还有多少问题在等着我。 所以请大家有时间的话能帮我试试。 能用、用不了、哪里有问题，都欢迎反馈。 非常感谢~

projects.title: Show HN: Sealr – E2EE messenger with per-message rules and screenshot blocking
projects.author: filoviercki
projects.summary: Sealr is an end-to-end encrypted messenger built on React Native and Firebase. It gives senders absolute post-send control by attaching cryptographic rules (views, expiry, geo-fencing) to each message. We use AES-256-GCM and RSA-OAEP-2048, enforcing permissions via Firestore rules without the server ever reading the content and without any plain-text and media ever being stored on the local device. Screen capture and mirroring is blocked at the OS level.

projects.title: Show HN: Gleamit – dental health tracker for Android/iOS
projects.author: Uaitt
projects.summary: Hi HN! I wanted to show the world a small project I have been working on, on my spare time, for the past couple of months. It's a small cross-platform mobile application that works as a dental health tracker. It helps your track really everything (I believe) regarding your dental/oral health. Features include: - daily reminders to brush your teeth in the morning, after lunch and before bed - a simple 2 minutes brushing timer and a streak counter to see your past brushing habits and get cool insights about your past brushing trends (like at which time of the day you usually brush, what's your most missed day...) - a teeth diagram where you can record your historical teeth conditions so that you never forget about them - a centralized planner for your dentist visits with reminders for your next appointments and a vault to store your documents - a toothbrushes pane where you can manage your active ones and get notified when a manual one or a brush head needs to be replaced (I always forget to do so!), like after 90 days - other minor but cool things like a photo comparer that allows you to compare your smile and if it's becoming whiter, an automatically generated PDF report to share to your dentist and more I built this because I was looking for something similar for my Android phone, but I wasn't able to find anything cool on the Play Store or something that I could be satisfied with, so I thought why not built it myself this time :) The cool thing about the app is that it has no backend - everything lives client side (didn't want to handle medical data at all on a backend - would have been a real mess to do so as a solo dev on a small side project!). You can turn on "cloud backups" though to save snapshots of your data to your Google Drive or iCloud on a schedule you can configure, think like how WhatsApp does it. Happy to know what HN thinks about this! :) any feedback is super appreciated, especially on what's missing or on bugs you find :D

projects.title: Show HN: CallFirst – blocks socials until you've made a call to someone
projects.author: fribble
projects.summary: Hi I'm Ben. I'm a product manager in London and I've been building this solo. CallFirst blocks socials until you make a phone call to someone, on a schedule you set. I made this because I found myself meaning to call my mum/mate/etc but ended up doomscrolling instead. A couple of things on the approach 1/ I don’t see any contact information, none is shared back with me, 2/ I don’t actually know you’ve made a phone call - I know you’ve been away from the app for more than 60 seconds, but my early testers found the nudge to stop doomscrolling and be reminded it’s time to call someone to be enough to get them to make the call! 3/ The hardest thing was stopping different Android phone makers from killing the social app monitoring I need to run. I only have 2 test phones, so had to find friends with different handsets! It’s always free for one contact, one schedule and to block one app, and comes with a free trial for unlimited blocking. Ping me if you want more of a trial via the contact form in the app. I'd love feedback especially on the parts that feel like friction for the sake of it. Thanks!!

projects.title: Show HN: Swarm, an offline family tree app for macOS
projects.author: samoilev

github.name: samoilev/swarm
github.description: Native macOS family tree editor. Genealogy stays in plain GEDCOM files on your disk, with offline place search, exact kinship terms, and no accounts or telemetry.

projects.summary: Hi HN! My wife and I got deep into our family genealogy and wanted to map out all our relatives - but keep the data on our own Macs instead of uploading it to a genealogy service. Nothing we found did that, so we built Swarm, a native macOS app in Swift. It's built on GEDCOM 5.5.1, the universal genealogy file standard, so your tree exports cleanly to other ancestry apps if you ever want out. Example trees of famous historical families are included to play with. Features: multiple ancestry views (tree, fan, world map), media files, GEDCOM import/export, PDF export, tree merging, and kinship naming. Fully open source, no AI in the app, no internet connection required, no account required. Would appreciate any feedback!

projects.title: Show HN: Radius – A Meetup.com Alternative
projects.author: radius89
projects.summary: Hello HN! I'm relaunching Radius [1] - far too long after the original Show HN [2] (I'll blame the day job for that). Radius started out from my frustration with not knowing what was going on around me. The initial plan was to "show all and every type of event" from big to small, but over time I narrowed the focus to communities, groups, events, and helping people connect through them. The initial Show HN gave me 150+ comments (surprising, looking back, given how terrible the plain Bootstrap UI was...) with a huge amount of useful feedback and feature requests. I've spent the time since then working through that, along with additional requests from groups using Radius, and it finally feels ready for a proper relaunch. I've also recently added "Activities" [3] - which are lightweight events, independent of groups, intended to help people find others to do things with - for example: > John is going for a cycle and a coffee in New York at 10am People can join and vote for a time that works for them. I've got a bunch of ideas for where to go next with this, including things like open sourcing and federation, but those are for another day! Any feedback would be greatly appreciated! P.S. it's built with Ruby on Rails, for those interested. I highly suspect it would have taken me 2 more years to get to this point without Rails! [1] https://radius.to/ [2] https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=40717398 [3] https://radius.to/documentation/activities/post-an-activity

projects.title: vibe 了个功能丰富的微博网页版美化和屏蔽插件，老哥们需要的自取
projects.author: gay4in
projects.summary: 折腾了一个微博网页版插件，叫「全能围脖」，有 Chrome 扩展版和油猴脚本版。 ![05-顶部宣传图.png]( ) ![01-统一设置.png]( ) ![02-日间配色.png]( ) ![03-夜间配色.png]( ) 起因也很简单：平时还会用电脑刷微博，但页面上不想看的东西有点多，美化、屏蔽和下载又经常要装好几个脚本。昨天看到 @aslan1 大佬的分享，索性借助 codex 折腾了一下，把这些功能整合到一个设置面板里，按需开关。上架了 chrome 插件商店 主要能做这些： - **页面美化**：调整卡片排版、图文比例，有 5 组日夜配色，也可以自定义文字和背景颜色；侧栏、发布框、Logo 等可以按喜好隐藏。 - **快速内容屏蔽**：支持关键词、正则、来源、超话等过滤，以及广告清理、AI 内容和过期微博过滤。以及即时点击用户屏蔽。 - **用户名单管理**：按 UID 过滤用户，支持名单导入导出、官方黑名单同步，在帖子、评论、搜索等场景里过滤不想看的内容。 - **时间线和页面精简**：可以切换最新时间线，调整推荐内容、导航和侧栏的显示。 - **截图和媒体工具**：Markdown 导出，图片、视频、LivePhoto 的选择与打包下载 功能看起来比较多，不过分成了四个模块，不需要的直接关掉就行。装好后刷新微博，点击右下角「围脖」就能打开设置。 先说明一下来源：这是基于 **MWCA 、微博综合屏蔽、Pynseq 、微博浏览助手** 做的整合和改造，保留了上游作者及许可说明，感谢原作者们的工作。 **安装地址：** - [Chrome 扩展版]( https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/pgginmnckecopnboblpbipalejimpnoj?utm_source=item-share-cb) - [油猴脚本版（ Greasy Fork ）]( https://greasyfork.org/zh-CN/scripts/596500) 扩展版和脚本版选一个装就行；如果已经装了上面提到的同类脚本，建议先停用，避免功能重复或冲突。 主要面向桌面网页版微博，微博改版后部分功能可能需要继续适配。老哥们有需要的可以试试，遇到 bug 或者有什么想要的功能，欢迎回帖。报问题时带一下浏览器版本、出问题的页面和复现步骤，方便我排查。

projects.title: 提交项目：FPS 帧律（C#）
projects.author: jidekaixin2dian

github.name: jidekaixin2dian/fps-tune
github.description: Windows 系统层帧率调校台：33 项优化全部可还原、不碰游戏文件，结论来自本机 A/B 实测。C# WPF + .NET 10，带无头 CLI 与 SKILL.md（AI Agent 可直接驱动）。适用于三角洲行动 / CS2 / 无畏契约 / APEX / PUBG。

projects.summary: 面向 FPS 玩家的 Windows 系统层调校工具（C# WPF + .NET 10）。它只改系统设置——注册表、电源计划、服务启动类型、启动配置，共 33 个优化项，全部集中在一个 catalog.json 里可以直接读完改了什么。每次写入前先备份原值（包括"这个键原本不存在"这种状态），所以能精确还原，也支持逐项还原。GUI 与无头 CLI 共用同一套引擎，附带 A/B 实验向导：改完自动对比平均帧率 / 1% low / P99 帧时间，没有可测收益的改动会被自动撤回。适用于《三角洲行动》《CS2》《无畏契约》《APEX》等，不针对特定游戏。 亮点 同类工具基本都是闭源 + 专有 EULA（禁止修改与再分发），并且不会告诉你它到底改了哪些键、也回不去。这个项目的差异点正好是这三件事：MIT 开源、clean-room 自写、改动全部可还原。另外它内置了"不承诺帧数"的机制——性能会话在本机采样 CPU/内存/GPU/显存，A/B 实验用规则判定收益，没提升就自动还原，避免"玄学优化"。仓库里还有一份 SKILL.md，把工具当作 AI Agent 的执行后端，Agent 只负责解释与确认，改动由确定性引擎完成。 截图或演示 我是这个项目的作者。目前是 0.1 Beta，二进制未做代码签名，Issues 我都回。
projects.summaryZh: 面向 FPS 玩家的 Windows 系统层调校工具（C# WPF + .NET 10）。
projects.titleEn: FPS FrameRate: Windows System Tuning for FPS Gamers (C#)
projects.summaryEn: Windows tuning tool for FPS gamers (C#) applying 33 registry, power, service and startup tweaks from one catalog.json, with per-item rollback. GUI and headless CLI share an engine; an A/B wizard auto-reverts gains that aren't measurable.

projects.title: bbhouse-qt, 基于 qt/qml 的跨平台 B 站客户端, 四年续作
projects.author: seelight
projects.summary: ![banner]( https://cos.endcloud.cn/v2ex/Xnip2026-09-19_14-40-19.png?imageMogr2/format/webp/thumbnail/!50p) ## [bbhouse-tauri]( https://www.v2ex.com/t/872704) 的精神续作, GPLv3 开源, [地址点这里]( https://github.com/endcloud/bbhouse-tauri-qt) ## 名字与契机 BBHouse, 取自经常能看见的"在 B 站买房"的评论. 源于个人是仓鼠党, 收藏爱好者, 对推荐流的抵抗为负; 外加关注了 3000+up 主, 无力审阅动态. 四年前的 tauri 版本有无法解决的问题: 杜比视界/低效的 IPC; WinUI 版本在 Windows 上性能问题都很大; SwiftUI 的 Vibe 效果实在不太好. 作为一个 Native 爱好者, 最终决定了 qt 版本, 解决所有问题. ## 已实现的功能 播放器: 播放列表, 杜比视界与 HDR 支持, 帧截图, 弹幕, 字幕, 倍速, 下载; 在线功能: (已关注的)动态与直播, 追番(港澳台), 流行, 特别关注; 历史记录, 稍后再看 请注意: ***无法会普通会员提供超过权限的功能*** ## feature 1. 极简, 以动态流为首页, 默认不展示 b 博, 没有推荐流 2. 动态流支持筛选 by 标题, up 主, 分区, 方便关注爆满的朋友 3. 单独生命周期的播放窗口与列表, 基于 mpv 后端, 支持杜比视界与 HDR 4. 对随机出现的 PCDN 进行了降权处理 5. 支持代理播放港澳台番剧 6. 完善的下载管理与本地导入弹幕播放功能 7. 现代化的 FluentUI, 明/暗, 多语言支持. 8. 高性能的 Native 应用, 采用全国***最小而美的 app(微信)***同源技术, qt+cpp 构建二进制 9. 跨平台(目前 release: Windows_x64, macOS_arm64) 10. 基于 cookie 认证, 轻依赖 ## 特色功能 1. 本地特别关注: 解决特别关注有上限的问题, 方便查看 UP 主空间, 追更 2. 本地历史缓存: 定期同步, 解决云历史有上限的问题 ## todo - 评论区 - AI 分析与推荐 - mpv 的 shader 插件, 如 anime4K ## vibe 声明 1. 本项目由于需要 FluentUI, port 自 WinUI 版本的同名项目与, port 时同步参考了原先的 taur 项目, 此过程使用 `Zcode GLM-5.3-flash` 完成 2. 多平台编译构建排错, 此过程使用 `Trae Kimi-K3` 完成 3. 细节与优化以及后续, 此过程使用 `Codex GPT-6-Astra` 完成 ## 致谢 ### mpv 后端的接入 - [Bili.Copilot]( https://github.com/Richasy/Bili.Copilot) - [wiliwili]( https://github.com/xfangfang/wiliwili) ### 弹幕实现与优化 - [DanmakuFrostMaster]( https://github.com/cotaku/DanmakuFrostMaster) - [Danmaku]( https://github.com/weizhenye/Danmaku) - [biliLocal]( https://github.com/ancientlysine/bililocal) - [pakku.js]( https://github.com/xmcp/pakku.js) ### 在线服务 - [bilibili-api-collect]() - [哔哩哔哩-干杯]( https://www.bilibili.com/space) ### 其他 - 向所有曾留言/star/pr 的 V 友致谢, 22 年的这个项目, 对我个人而言, 在工作和生活中, 都带来了莫大鼓励. ## 尾声 碎碎念 AI 四年前的[bbhouse-tauri](), 开发时间 2 周, 只有 1/10 的模板 ts 是 copilot 生成的, 当时我甚至为 copilot 能自动识别 macOS/Windows 的不同 path 而兴奋; 今年的[bbhouse-qt](), 开发时间 3 天, 算上 port 和走的弯路, 也是两周, 全程由 harness+LLM 接管, 哪怕最后接入的 Astra 也只是让我"有些兴奋". 今年四月我退订了续费 5 年的 copilot, 然后是中转站和各种 plan. 至少到目前为止, 我还是很兴奋, 工作也还在, 只是项目变大了, 变多了:) 希望大家与 AI 都能有一个美好的未来. ## 实机截图 ![动态]( https://cos.endcloud.cn/v2ex/Xnip2026-09-19_14-40-42.png?imageMogr2/format/webp/thumbnail/!50p) ![流行]( https://cos.endcloud.cn/v2ex/Xnip2026-09-19_14-40-52.png?imageMogr2/format/webp/thumbnail/!50p) ![直播]( https://cos.endcloud.cn/v2ex/Xnip2026-09-19_14-40-32.png?imageMogr2/format/webp/thumbnail/!50p) ![番剧-港澳台]( https://cos.endcloud.cn/v2ex/Xnip2026-09-19_14-45-06.png?imageMogr2/format/webp/thumbnail/!50p) ![特别关注]( https://cos.endcloud.cn/v2ex/Xnip2026-09-19_14-41-05.png?imageMogr2/format/webp/thumbnail/!50p) ![本地历史缓存]( https://cos.endcloud.cn/v2ex/Xnip2026-09-19_14-42-11.png?imageMogr2/format/webp/thumbnail/!50p) ![播放器]( https://cos.endcloud.cn/v2ex/Xnip2026-09-19_14-46-09.png?imageMogr2/format/webp/thumbnail/!50p)

projects.title: Show HN: Stardrift – A 3D galaxy of all music, to explore and learn
projects.author: sovok
projects.summary: Music streaming services have tons of music, but no easy way to simply shuffle over all of it, or explore it outside of their recommendation algorithms. So I took the database of 43m songs from Musicbrainz.org and made my own player, with b̶l̶a̶c̶k̶j̶a̶c̶k̶ ̶a̶n̶d̶ Wikipedia integration and playback via Apples MusicKit, plus a 3D VR version via WebXR. Short demo: https://stardrift.gerlach.dev/demo/stardrift.mp4 Direct link to the 3D galaxy: https://stardrift.gerlach.dev/galaxy That last bit was the most fun to build (with AI help) and thus escalated a bit into a VR playground. 2.3 million stars/albums, a custom Three.js UI kit and a bunch of extras to have something to do while the music plays. Like a full-size USS Enterprise to fly around with Jerry Goldsmiths soundtrack. Or a Mahjong game, black hole, Theremin, banana duck etc. Works best on Quest 3 and /should/ be useable on a Vision Pro with gestures. If you have an AVP, I would appreciate feedback, the Xcode simulator only goes so far. The Venn diagram of people liking to explore random music, having an Apple Music account and a VR headset is probably pretty small, but I for one love it and have discovered a bunch of new music and learned a lot. Frontend built with Svelte 5, Three.js, backend PHP. It takes about 50GB in Postgres + ~150GB for cover images. I'll keep it online as long as my little VPS doesn't melt.

projects.title: Lacquer: Hi-Res FLAC Verifier
projects.summary: Lacquer analyses lossless audio files on iPhonelikely transcoded or upscaled from a lossy source. projects.title: Show HN: Seal – Letters and passwords that open for your family after you die
projects.author: jpage2
projects.summary: I'm a CS undergrad who has developed an interest in hardware keys ever since I used them for a school project a few years ago. I made a little chat app that only allows users to chat if they registered a key, nothing else. The backstory of how I came to work on Seal (this project): was that I was generating ideas with Claude to come up with an idea that only hardware keys could make into software. I was thinking about physical house keys and what you could do with those, but in software. I was already making iOS apps with Claude, and I came up with this idea and it sounded good. I had already worked on a few projects involving hardware keys and I already loved them. Today I submitted my latest app, Seal, for review in the app store. Seal is an iOS app for iPhone and iPad that lets you write an Envelope (an encrypted bundle of passwords, photos, voice memos, etc...) for all of your loved ones when you're gone. You can register hardware keys and assign identities for each person. Then you can create Envelopes and assign them to the key that you want to distribute. They plug in the key to their phone and are ready to receive an Envelope from you. If you don't log into the app for months, one of your designated key holders can start the process of opening the Sealed Envelope. You, as the writer of the letters, get weeks of warnings to check in at least once before the letters open. After 90 days of countdown, 21 days of warnings, and 14 days of grace, the envelope opens for each person they met IRL and exchange keys with. No one else can read the envelope or see the photos (even the key holders, Apple, or me) unless that envelope was designated for that person. What's different from a password manager like 1Password: emergency access there hands one person your whole vault through the company's server, so it needs that company to still exist and be honest on the day it matters. Seal gives each person their own envelope nobody else can open, and there's no company in the middle. There's also no server at all besides a free Cloudflare static site. The encrypted bundles of passwords and photos are in Cloud Kit. Sign-in/identity is a passkey Face ID/Touch ID or a Hardware Key. It's all Crypto Kit, so there's no dependencies required. Currently, it's just me and Claude working on this. It hasn't been independently audited by anyone, and it's iPhone only for now. Please do not put a live seed phrase in it yet. If anyone has advice for me as the lead developer for this project, I'm all ears! You can help contribute on the github source code repository page if you'd like. My mom likes this app especially because she's into crypto and she needed a way to pass down or give away the seed phrases for her wallets to all 3 kids without any question about who gets what and when. In the end, there's no confusion or hurt feelings after the fact with just crypto. Thank you for reading and let me know if you have any questions or concerns for me or the project! Source: https://github.com/jasonepage/Seal Site with limits and objections pages: https://sealmessenger.com Free on TestFlight while the App Store version is in review: https://testflight.apple.com/join/cYp9JRCG

projects.title: 做了个英文 self-discovery 测验站：不给一个标签，结果也不上锁
projects.author: zizhu2
projects.summary: 最近上线了一个面向英文用户的小站： https://loretypes.com ( https://loretypes.com) 不是又一个「测完告诉你是哪种人」的壳。首页那句是产品决定，不是文案： │ Three free self-discovery quizzes. Your whole pattern, not one label. 现在三套，每套 21–24 题，3–4 分钟： • Aura Color：八色光谱，主色旁边的分数还在 • Archetype：五个模式 + 一个 supporting type • Moral Alignment：九宫格，两条轴都给 做这个站之前看过一圈英文测验站，最烦两件事：测完要邮箱，完整报告锁在付费墙后面。所以这三套现在都是：不注册、不留邮箱、测完就能看完整结果，链接能分享。 几个自己比较在意的决定，也想听听你们拍砖： 1. 计分只认服务端。 同一组答案，手机和电脑必须出同一个结果。客户端不算分，避免「刷新变了一种人」。结果是 12 位 shareId ，OG 图按结果生成，方便丢到推特/Reddit 。 2. 主结果不是一枚印章。Aura / Archetype 把邻近分数留在画面上，Alignment 把九宫格和两条轴一起给。领先项可以看，但不把它写成「你就是这个人」。 3. AI 是加料，不是测验本身。Archetype 出分之后可以选场景，生成一段日常/协作向的反思。默认不请求模型；原始答题不上模型，生成内容不落库、不进分享链接。现在用的 是智谱。额度很小，挂了也不影响你看原来的结果。 4. 站上写清楚：这不是科学，也不是诊断。 灵感来自性格、颜色、价值这些大家熟悉的框架，用来想自己最近怎么做事，不当测评报告。 技术上没花活：Next.js App Router ，Postgres 存结果，Upstash 做限流。难点不在框架，在「短测验怎么既好玩、又不装权威」。英文 SEO 这条路也很挤，16personalities 那种体量碰不起，只能靠体验和页面把长尾接住。 求拍砖的几件事： • 三套一起放首页，会不会反而说不清这站是干什么的？ • 21–24 题这个长度，英文用户会不会还是嫌长？ • AI 反思现在是可选。有人觉得该默认出，有人觉得测验站不该碰模型。你们怎么看？ • 文案上「 not a diagnosis 」会不会太反复，看着像免责声明站？ 站点是英文的，中文用户不是目标用户。如果只是随手点开看一眼结构，也欢迎直接说哪里像套壳、哪里假正经。 目前没付费墙，也没计划靠 V2EX 冲流量。就是做完了，想让做产品的人过一眼。

projects.title: Show HN: dishlist – my favorite things on the menu
projects.author: coopers
projects.summary: Hi HN! My friend and I wanted to rank our favorite breakfast burritos. Yelp and Beli allow users to rate or rank restaurants, but not individual dishes. So I built dishlist, an iPhone app around the things on restaurant menus. I schlepped around Dogpatch, Potrero Hill, and Mission Bay taking photos of restaurant menus. Then, I used Claude with my menu schema to turn the photos into structured data. Garry Tan likes to say, "The rocks can talk." Also, "The rocks can see." I represent the menu hierarchy in the database. LLMs can determine what type of thing each menu item is. This lets me index things like breakfast burritos across restaurants rather than just indexing the restaurants themselves. The app suggests possible tags for a menu item. You decide which ones you want to use on your profile. You can build a list of your favorite breakfast burritos, pizzas, burgers, or whatever else you care about. I value my privacy, so you can use the app without logging in at all. If you want to save menu items, you can sign in with Apple. I don't collect names, emails, or phone numbers. If you want to share with friends, you can add a handle. You have to follow another user to see their dishlist, and they have to follow you to see yours. Follow requests are approved or denied by the user. The app is currently available through TestFlight while the App Store submission is being reviewed. https://testflight.apple.com/join/VB1YAe63 I'd love feedback on the idea, the search experience, and especially whether organizing things around individual menu items feels useful.

projects.summary: Loretypes（ ）是一个英文的自我探索小测验网站，目前有 6 个测验： 光环颜色测试（Aura Color Test）：21 题，看 8 种颜色里哪种居首，其余颜色的分布也一起显示 原型测试（Archetype Test）：24 题，原创的 10 型模型，五个维度，给出主类型和辅助类型 道德阵营测试（Moral Alignment Test）：24 题，结果落在九宫格阵营图上 前世测验（Past Life Quiz）：24 题，结果是虚构的故事角色，只为好玩，不声称揭示真实的前世 色彩季型测验（Color Season Quiz）：24 题，问的是你喜欢哪些配色，不需要上传照片 守护动物测验（Spirit Animal Quiz）：24 题，用 8 种动物做比喻 每个测验 3–4 分钟，不用注册、不留邮箱，完整结果免费看，可以生成分享链接。 测验计分是固定规则，不用 AI。原型测试做完后，可以选择让 AI 针对某个场景（比如团队合作）写一段反思，这是可选功能，每天有次数上限。 这些测验只用于自我反思和娱乐，不是心理学或临床诊断。 我是这个网站的作者，独立开发。欢迎试用和提意见。

projects.title: 【工具自荐】BugBnB（虫虫民宿）：垃圾桶一臭，果蝇、蚂蚁、蟑螂就住到你的桌面上（macOS 原生）
projects.author: asmoker
projects.summary: 大家好，自荐一个我自己做的 macOS 小应用 BugBnB（中文名「虫虫民宿」），免费。设定很直白：你的废纸篓就是一家民宿，垃圾桶一发臭，住客就上门。 它是怎么运作的 一直盯着废纸篓：有多大、多少个项目、最早的一项放了多久、磁盘还剩多少空间。这几条规则想开几条开几条，任意一条满足就「开张」，阈值都能自己调 住客有五种：果蝇、蚂蚁、蟑螂、蛾蠓、蚊子。谁来、来几只、多大个头都由你定，最多 20 只，分小 / 中 / 大三档；可以一次到齐，也可以每 15 分钟到 2 小时来一批 清倒废纸篓时，一辆小垃圾车从屏幕边缘开进来，倒车靠到程序坞的废纸篓旁边，把桶抬起来倒进车斗——垃圾桶清空的那一刻，垃圾刚好倒进去，然后它从另一侧开走。柴油机换挡、气刹、倒车蜂鸣、喇叭，声音都有 受够了就打开「除虫柜」：轰走（不伤性命）、杀虫剂、喷火。用完会留一段冷却期，暂时没有新住客 虫子不是随机乱飞的 每种都照着真实习性写： 果蝇顺着气味「冲刺-摆动」地靠近，扫视式锯齿飞行；落在桶边用口器点食、搓前足 蚂蚁先派一只侦察蚁探路，回巢路上留下信息素，同伴再排队沿路径来回搬面包屑，碰面还要碰碰触角 蟑螂有趋触性，贴着屏幕边缘跑，走走停停扫触角；昼伏夜出，受惊会冲到屏幕外躲起来 蛾蠓飞行能力弱，跳飞一小段就长时间歇着，翅膀收成一颗心 蚊子在你鼠标不动的时候凑过来叮一口，肚子慢慢涨红，吸饱了飞得更慢 它们会在你的所有显示器之间漫游，走的是屏幕真正相邻的那条边；鼠标一靠近就四散，点中一只它会夺路而逃，过一会儿先探头、僵住，确认安全了才慢慢挪回来。 实现上 原生 Swift + Core Graphics，没有 Electron。昆虫先按「标本图」的标准矢量绘制（复眼的小眼、刚毛、翅脉的薄膜干涉色、足刺都画了），再拆成可动的骨骼部件，动作帧在后台一次性烘焙成精灵图集，桌面上每只只切换图集区域并更新位置与阴影。菜单栏应用，几乎不占资源。 隐私上很干净：不用注册、没有账号、不收集数据，联网只有每天一次检查更新和一次匿名启动计数，两件都能关掉。鼠标点击会直接穿过昆虫落到下面的窗口上；除非你点「清倒垃圾桶」，它不会打开、移动或删除任何文件。 下载 macOS 11 Big Sur 及以上，Apple 芯片与 Intel 通用，免费、不上架 App Store。 一个说明：目前用自签名证书发布，还没做 Apple 公证，第一次打开需要在「应用程序」里按住 Control 点一下图标，再选「打开」；之后的更新由应用内完成，不会再被拦。

projects.summary: kukuri is a topic-first decentralized social network built for choosing communities, not platforms. Instead of putting one server or algorithm in control, it lets users discover conversations by topic, choose Community Nodes they trust for indexing and moderation, and keep identity and content portable across the network. It combines P2P gossip distribution with delegated trust, so decentralization doesn’t mean every user has to manage everything themselves.
projects.summaryZh: 主题优先的去中心化社交网络，按主题发现对话，选择可信社区节点做索引和审核，身份与内容可跨网络迁移。
projects.summaryEn: kukuri is a topic-first decentralized social network built for choosing communities, not platforms.

projects.title: Wingman
projects.summary: You meant to text her. Then the day got busy. Wingman for iPhone brings reminders, editable message ideas, and your own drafts together. Choose your days and time, make the words yours, then open Messages or WhatsApp and tap Send yourself. No automatic texts or conversation scanning. Available in English, Spanish, French, and Brazilian Portuguese. One purchase. No subscription, account, ads, or tracking.
projects.summaryZh: iPhone 约会短信提醒应用，整合提醒、可编辑消息灵感与草稿，选好时间后手动在 Messages 或 WhatsApp 发送，无自动发送与订阅追踪，支持四种语言。
projects.summaryEn: You meant to text her. Then the day got busy. Wingman for iPhone brings reminders, editable message ideas, and your own drafts together. Choose your days and time, make the words yours, then open Messages or WhatsApp and tap Send yourself.

projects.title: Mela
projects.summary: Pick a game and play—no download or signup wall. Mela brings 18 browser games into one shared playground: play solo, invite friends, bring an AI agent to supported games, or join the crowd and influence the match. Run a three-game Circuit with your group, join by QR, and revisit scorecards, clips and playable memories. WebMCP and remote MCP let agents take part under the same game rules. Eighteen games is just the start.
projects.summaryZh: Mela 将 18 款浏览器游戏聚合成共享游乐场，无需下载注册，支持单人、邀请好友、AI Agent 参与和 QR 加入。
projects.summaryEn: Pick a game and play—no download or signup wall. Mela brings 18 browser games into one shared playground: play solo, invite friends, bring an AI agent to supported games, or join the crowd and influence the match.

projects.title: Matchaboy — Good games. Greener days.
projects.summary: Matchaboy turns handheld gaming into hands-on discovery. Play Game Boy and Game Boy Advance games, then pause and explore CPU instructions, memory, graphics and sound through a built-in Inspector. Free and open source, with two included indie games and direct host/join netplay. Built with Astra in Codex: an original Game Boy engine, mGBA-powered GBA support, and ten original game experiments available in the source.
projects.summaryZh: 开源掌机模拟器，可玩 Game Boy/GBA，内置 Inspector 探索 CPU、内存、图形与声音，含独立游戏与联机。
projects.summaryEn: Matchaboy turns handheld gaming into hands-on discovery. Play Game Boy and Game Boy Advance games, then pause and explore CPU instructions, memory, graphics and sound through a built-in Inspector.

projects.title: Praxis Gala
projects.summary: Praxis Gala is a gallery where the exhibits actually work. Walk between creative studios, playable games, a reading room, and historical art, film, and voices. Create a world draft in the Maker Studio, then open that same saved revision in the Game Studio. The distinction is the connected experience: tools and creations share a navigable place rather than disappearing into separate tabs. It runs in your browser, with downloadable work and hidden rooms worth discovering.
projects.summaryZh: 浏览器互动画廊，展品真正可用：在创作工作室、可玩游戏、阅读室与历史艺术影音间穿行，Maker Studio 创建的世界草稿可在 Game Studio 打开同一修订。
projects.summaryEn: Praxis Gala is a gallery where the exhibits actually work. Walk between creative studios, playable games, a reading room, and historical art, film, and voices.

projects.title: Web-Maze Human vs Astra
projects.summary: Web-Maze is a first-person 3D maze you play right in the browser - designed live by OpenAI's Astra. Astra builds each level's layout, theme and story, then instantly forgets it and races you through its own creation, navigating blind from nothing but what it has personally explored - exactly like you. Every move is a real, live decision, not a pre-baked path. First to the exit wins: beat Astra to advance, or get sent back to retry the level. Mazes grow bigger and harder each level.
projects.summaryZh: 浏览器中的第一人称3D迷宫游戏，由OpenAI的Astra实时设计关卡并与你竞速，先到出口者胜。
projects.summaryEn: Web-Maze is a first-person 3D maze you play right in the browser - designed live by OpenAI's Astra.

projects.title: HomeLedger: Family Money

Records stay on your devices by default, with optional private iCloud backup. No account, ads, subscriptions, forced conversion, or developer tracking. Free to download with an optional one-time Lifetime purchase.

projects.summaryEn: Welcome to Puzzle Empire. Test your skills, sharpen your mind, and conquer thousands of exciting puzzles across multiple game modes.

projects.title: Drawing Arena
projects.summary: Drawing Arena turns a 60-second sketch into a live AI race. You get a secret word, draw it, and independent AI models try to identify your picture every five seconds—without seeing each other’s answers. Mystery matchups keep model identities hidden until the reveal, and every finished race can become a replay challenge for friends. It’s a game first, but also a fun way to see how differently vision models interpret the same drawing.
projects.summaryZh: 将60秒涂鸦变成AI竞猜赛：秘密词作画，多个独立视觉模型每5秒识别，揭晓前隐藏身份，成品可作回放挑战。
projects.summaryEn: Drawing Arena turns a 60-second sketch into a live AI race. You get a secret word, draw it, and independent AI models try to identify your picture every five seconds—without seeing each other’s answers.

projects.title: Show HN: Things To Have – free, privacy caring, mighty wishlist app
projects.author: brachkow
projects.summary: Things To Have is a wishlist app. I started working on it in 2022 as a pet project for my friends, then turned it into a serious app in 2024. I built it because I disliked other such apps – they were either too ephemeral, limited to a specific use case, or felt like a TV shop. I wanted to build an app that would be calm and would cater to thoughtful buyers, collectors, and enthusiasts. I also didn't forget about birthdays, so reservations and other birthday QoL are present. As it always was a hobby/passion project, I wasn't bothered by "time to market" and overengineered a lot of things. For example, it ships transparency-aware blurhash for each image, has many unadvertised Drag'n'Drop interactions like MacOS has, 1001 ways to upload files into a form, etc. It is also powered by a quirky stack: it is running on Cloudflare Workers and D1, and the code is written using Hono ( https://hono.dev/ ) and Vue, tied together by a custom Inertia ( https://github.com/brachkow/hono-inertia ) adapter. I also use better-result ( https://better-result.dev/ ) to bring sane errors to JavaScript. All this results in a scalable, cheap, and extremely easy way to write full-stack apps, which feels like old-fashioned MVC. I believe my app stands out from both established apps and beige vibecoded competitors and is worth your try. And if not, I hope you find the listed tech fun at least...

projects.title: Show HN: Hometowns – Map the area codes in your contacts list
projects.author: benaduggan
projects.summary: I've always been interested in area codes because we all tend to keep our first phone number and it tells a little bit of your life story. I probably only know 5 area codes that really excite me because I'm familiar with the area, but I've wondered how many others are from areas I'm familiar with, but I'm just not familiar with the area code. So in full transparency, this project came together because I finally threw an LLM at it. I've had this project written down for probably 10 years, and the initial commit to this repo was 5 years ago. It parses your contacts, and shows you a map of where they are from (North America only). You can also choose to share it with someone else and see the overlap of your maps which I found really fascinating too. I recognize it's a big ask to enter names and phone numbers into a random site, but this is published to github pages and the source code is right there. It is all fully client-side, no data collection, no network requests or anything. You can run it in airplane mode / disable networking on the tab once it's loaded too. Hopefully others find it fun too!

projects.title: Show HN: Halo 3's Guardian, playable in the browser, as my personal website
projects.author: runshouse
projects.summary: I've never had a personal website, and I didn't want to make a resume/portfolio site, so I rebuilt Guardian and hid a treasure hunt through my life inside it. You start in the Halo 3 main menu, go through the lobby, spawn in the map, and explore. There are photos, stories, quests, mini-games, and Easter eggs scattered around. Movement is via WASD and mouse, no signup. Guardian was my third place growing up. Starting in 9th grade, my friends and I would get home after school, get on Halo, and hang out in a Guardian free-for-all with MLG settings until everyone came online, then play customs or ranked for hours. On weekends we'd bring our Xboxes and monitors to each other's houses, stay up all night, and play in local tournaments. Guardian was probably the closest thing I had to a digital home, so I wanted my site to live there. Playing it and hearing the theme music for the first time in 10+ years in a place I knew by heart felt a bit like coming home. The map itself isn't AI-generated. It uses an original Guardian asset export distributed through the fan-run Halo Archive: an OBJ with 115,250 faces, the original UV coordinates, and 42 referenced diffuse textures, loaded through Three.js. What was AI-generated was everything on top needed to turn it into a complete game: shaders, lighting, scenario tags, physics, animations, collision, movement, sky and fog, lifts, pickups, weapon handling, and quest routing. Every pickup was placed by hand against the geometry using callout maps and a dev-only coordinate locator. This was surprisingly tedious to get right - I think it took me 10 iterations just to get the blue lift on Camo to line up parallel with the ledge. The Guardian geometry and texture assets are 21 MB, so the load is hidden inside the lobby countdown and scorecard screen while the shaders warm up. It targets 60 FPS and feels smooth on a recent MacBook in Chrome. Touch controls work on mobile, but the field of view is roughly 20 degrees in portrait, so desktop is definitely the best way to play it. I built it with Codex using Astra. It wrote essentially all of the code: 20,552 lines of TypeScript across 118 files, 973M tokens, 37 hours of runtime, and about 25-30 hours of my time. Coding wasn't the hard part. The time-consuming part was deciding which memories belonged in the map, where each should live, what game mechanic fit each one best, and then playing it over and over to fix bugs and get the movement and user flow to feel right. I'll write up more about the Codex/Astra side in a comment since I had a lot of interesting learnings from building something this large with it. This is an unofficial fan project and I'm not making money from it. The geometry, textures, UI, and many of the sound effects are Halo material and belong to their respective owners. Some things are still rough. There's occasional lag when picking up a power weapon. The lifts don't feel quite natural - it was hard to replicate the vacuum effect of the real lifts. On some browsers like Firefox, audio needs a click before it starts. Would love feedback on how it could be improved, especially from anyone else who spent a lot of time on this map.

projects.title: Show HN: I built a simple couples app that explores a new way of connecting them
projects.author: Swadesh9422
projects.summary: Hello HN. I built my first serious mobile (OS - Android) application, Lune. Before I tell you about it, I wanna tell you the backstory in short: One day I woke up from a bad dream and had an instant anxiety attack (I don't get those easily). I needed to call someone I love in that moment, but it wasn't practical given the time of the day. I just needed a way to feel that person's presence. In that moment, the idea behind Lune was born (currently I've pivoted from the original idea a bit though :). The thing is, as we get busier with our lives, it becomes increasingly difficult to stay meaningfully connected with our partner, texts can sit unread for hours, calls can become impractical for all kinds of reasons. If we feel something, how do we express it without starting a call or a chat conversation? How do we express a feeling in a way that stays with our partner, without demanding a reply? So I thought what if I could whisper my subtle feelings, so that my partner doesn't have to a reply and feel that whisper whenever they got the time. Before I list the features and explain why I picked them, I want to explain the name, Lune: Lune means Moon in French. No matter where you're from in this world, you've certainly felt the calm, ambient presence of a glowing moon on a dark night. It gives us a sense of belonging and closeness. In Lune, your partner is your moon. I've tried to recreate that same ambient feeling inside the app (I am constantly working on making it more and more beautiful, calm and ambient), so you can feel your partner's presence in the most beautiful way. Features: 1. Widget: A simple widget that shows your partner's presence, always. 2. Whisper: a very short text. Send one and it appears directly on the widget, staying there until the next one is sent. 3. Status: what your partner is up to (e.g. commuting, studying). Seven defaults, but you can create your own. 4. Mood: what your partner is feeling. Same as status: seven defaults, but you can create as many as you want. 5. Battery level: tells a lot about a person's well-being when combined with other context, like time of day or last active. 6. Landscapes Scenes: Well technically it's not a 'feature', but more of a characteristic of the app. Lune has a set of beautiful, ambient landscapes/scenes where you and your partner can spend some time together, exchanging whispers. This serves more to the feel of the app than to the utility. (Note: Currently there are 3 scenes, I'm adding more one by one) 7. And, of course, a beautiful moon. I'd like to hear your thoughts on the approach I'm taking to connect two people in love. And also the app's design is the second most important aspect for Lune after the concept itself, so share your thoughts on that too, I'm a novice in design, but taking help from Claude Design and trying to make Lune's home-screen as beautiful as possible :) Play Store Link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fusionfroz... One thing: HN guide said "Please make it easy for users to try your thing out", but I've only published on Play Store and due to its architecture it requires to sign up and connect with your partner in order to experience the core features and the design. projects.title: 【游戏分享】Copero：如果让你自己决定一名球员的职业生涯
projects.author: melodyxian
projects.summary: Copero 最近发现了一个挺有意思的浏览器足球游戏，叫 Copero。 它不是那种控制球员踢一场比赛的足球游戏，而是更偏向“职业生涯模拟”。你需要先创建自己的球员，从 16 岁开始选择国籍、号码、惯用脚、场上位置和比赛风格，然后开始自己的职业生涯。之后每个赛季都会根据你的选择和模拟结果继续发展，直到最终退役。 我觉得比较有意思的是，Copero 不只是单纯给你生成一份球员数据，而是把职业生涯拆成了很多实际选择。 比如刚开始的时候，你需要面对第一份合同，比较球队提供的角色、预计出场时间、工资和合同期限。之后还可能遇到转会、续约、租借、伤病以及国家队征召等情况，每一次选择都会影响后面的职业轨迹。 位置的选择也会影响整个模拟过程。目前可以选择 12 个位置，包括前锋、中场、后卫和门将。不同位置关注的数据也不一样，比如前锋更看重进球和进攻机会，而门将则会有自己的扑救、零封和失球表现。 另外还有一个我觉得挺适合反复玩的地方：没有一条固定的最佳路线。 你可以选择留在同一家俱乐部，尝试成为球队传奇；也可以不断转会，到不同国家体验不同的职业轨迹。网站还设置了忠诚、国家队和探索等不同成就目标。 整个游戏可以直接在浏览器里玩，不需要注册，也不需要下载安装。完成职业生涯后，还可以查看完整的职业履历，并保存自己的结果卡。 如果你喜欢足球经理、职业生涯模式，或者只是想看看“如果我从 16 岁开始踢职业足球，最后会变成什么样”，这个小游戏可以玩一下。 我自己比较喜欢这种不需要花很多时间学习规则，几分钟就能开始一段新职业生涯的游戏。

projects.summary: 最近做了一个比较简单的小工具，叫 Face Shape Snap，主要是帮大家快速判断自己的脸型。 很多时候我们想换发型、挑眼镜，或者参考一些妆容建议，但第一步往往是先搞清楚自己的脸型。问题是，单纯照着镜子判断其实挺容易搞错的，尤其是 Oval、Oblong、Round 这几种比较接近的类型。 所以我做了一个可以直接通过照片分析脸型的小工具。 使用方式很简单：上传一张正面照片，或者直接调用摄像头，Face Shape Snap 会分析脸部关键点，然后根据额头、颧骨、下颌以及脸部长度之间的比例，判断属于哪一种脸型。目前支持 7 种常见类型： Oval Round Square Heart Diamond Oblong Triangle 比较方便的一点是，整个分析过程直接在浏览器中进行，照片不会上传到服务器。网站也不需要注册账号、邮箱或者安装 App，打开就可以使用。 识别出脸型之后，还可以继续查看对应的风格指南，比如发型、眼镜和妆容方面的建议。这样它不只是告诉你“你是什么脸型”，而是可以继续帮助你把这个结果用到实际的造型选择上。 我觉得这个工具比较适合那些准备换发型、买眼镜、研究妆容，或者单纯好奇自己到底是什么脸型的人。 如果你也经常分不清自己到底是 Oval 还是 Oblong、Round 还是 Square，可以试试看。

projects.title: Show HN: HonestSky, a free iOS weather app without ads or subscriptions
projects.author: sph130
projects.summary: Hi HN, I’m Sean. I built HonestSky because I was tired of weather apps that were slow to load, covered in ads some to the point of being unusable and then putting longer forecasts behind paywalls. I’ve been using it myself for over a year, and today I finally (finally finally) released it on the iOS App Store. It includes hourly and extended forecasts, radar, severe weather alerts, and air quality. All features are free, with no ads or account required. Privacy was another reason I wanted to build it. Reading about the location-data lawsuits involving weather apps made me uncomfortable with how a straightforward weather lookup could turn into something else. This is something I didn’t realize until after I was looking for how to get the word out. You can save locations and opt into push notifications for weather alerts. It uses that information only to provide your forecasts and alerts. I don’t sell your data or use it for anything else. The weather data comes from providers including Open-Meteo, RainViewer, and the National Weather Service. This started as something I wanted for myself. After using it for a year, I figured other people might find it useful too. Plus it costs a few bucks to host and process so I put a donation bucket out there.. although Apple made me take any sort of asking for donations out of it so I haven’t figured that part out yet. I’d appreciate feedback on the interface, the forecasts and alerts, and anything that would stop you from using it as your everyday weather app. Happy to discuss the data sources and privacy decisions too. Cheers! Sean

projects.title: Show HN: Gescom MiniDisc Runner – 88 tracks, 88! possible orders
projects.author: austinallegro
projects.summary: NOTE: For a full backstory on this project, please see my blog post here which explains the absurd mathematics behind this unique music album. I hope you enjoy it! Blog Post: https://ei3lh.eu/2026/09/13/gescom-minidisc-and-mind-bogglin... Hello! I made a small Python program to solve a completely unnecessary problem: listening to Gescom's 1998 'MiniDisc' album in every possible order. The album has 88 pieces, which gives us: 88! = 1.8548264225739844 × 10^134 possible sequences. Obviously, making a playlist containing all of them would incur a slight storage problem! So instead, 'Gescom Runner' generates one 88-track M3U at a time, hands it to VLC (or player of your choice), waits for the playlist to finish, records where it got to, and generates the next permutation. It can resume after rebooting, jump directly to a particular permutation, and doesn't need to store the astronomical number of playlists. The complete journey would take approximately 2.37 × 10^130 years, so I'm reasonably confident nobody will be filing a completion report anytime soon! For transparency, I used AI and Wolfram to help write and document the code, and I've included that disclosure in the repository readme.md. The music isn't included — you provide your own legally obtained copy. GitHub: https://github.com/EI3LH/Gescom-MiniDisc-Runner I am no mathematician or hardcore developer, just a (very amateur) curious hobbyist, but I am particularly interested in whether there are interesting ways to improve the permutation generation, playback handling, or the general absurdity of the project. Thank you! EI3LH

github.description: 余量：把可穿戴数据变成一条可追溯、可被身体感受否决的今日安排 / Local-first wearable decision companion

projects.summary: 我是 余量 Yuliang 的维护者。想自荐这个 MIT 开源、本地优先的小工具。 手表记录了睡眠、HRV 和静息心率，但你今天觉得累，或者设备漏了记录：原定活动是否要调整，依据是什么？余量尝试把这些信息放在一张可以检查依据的建议卡上，而不是再给一个黑盒分数。 可以先用 中文在线演示 试三个情境，无需安装、注册或提供健康数据： 1. 点击“今天有点累”，看主观精力如何影响原计划，而不是由某个 HRV 数字直接下结论。 2. 点击“设备漏了记录”，看缺失值为何不应该被当成零或状态差。 3. 勾选“假设出现疼痛不适”，看它如何覆盖其他情境，不继续推荐原定活动。 页面会展开每条建议的依据和合成历史样本。以上全部是虚构演示，不是我的真实健康记录，也不是用户使用效果证明。 当前更适合愿意折腾本地数据的可穿戴设备用户，不是面向所有跑者的即装即用产品。 本地版支持主动选择的日汇总 JSON；已有兼容 garmin-grafana 的本机数据库时，可启用实验性只读适配器。不登录 Garmin、不自动同步，也不是官方集成。生成式 AI 默认关闭，核心流程使用可检查的确定性规则。 目前是早期公共预览，规则没有临床验证，不能判断训练安全或替代医疗建议。想征集首批试用反馈：试完一个合成情境后，这张卡是否值得你接入自己的数据继续使用？如果不值得，最大的原因是什么？ 可以直接在本帖回复，不需要分享健康指标、账号或私人截图。演示试用反馈与实际数据接入、持续使用会分别记录，不把它们混为采用。

projects.title: Waypath
projects.summary: Most run trackers hand you a time. Waypath tells you what it was worth. Grade-adjusted pace uses the published Minetti cost-of-running curve, so a 5:52 kilometre up a 5% grade reads as the 4:30 effort it really was. projects.title: 【开源自荐】jellyfin-rust：用 Rust 重写的 Jellyfin 媒体服务器，一套服务同时兼容 Jellyfin 和 Emby 两套 API
projects.author: dydydd
projects.summary: 我是 jellyfin-rust 的作者，自荐这个 GPL-2.0 的个人项目。 它是一个用 Rust 重写的 Jellyfin 媒体服务器：同一套领域服务同时暴露 Jellyfin API（根路径及 /api）和 Emby API（/emby），两套 HTTP contract 共享 PostgreSQL 数据层，Jellyfin/Emby 的官方客户端都能直连。技术栈是 Axum + SeaORM，Cargo workspace 按职责拆成十几个 crate。 当前能力 用户 / 设备 / API Key / 认证权限，媒体库扫描（电影、剧集、照片、书籍，ffprobe 提取媒体流，支持增量扫描与文件系统监听） 条目查询、搜索筛选、收藏、播放状态与历史；播放列表、合集、艺术家聚合页 图片处理（缩略图、blurhash、上传/交换）、本地字幕、Trickplay 预览 直接播放路径支持 HTTP Range / 206；SyncPlay、Quick Connect、Session 命令 TMDB 元数据远程搜索与刷新、NFO 本地元数据；Live TV 底层组件（XMLTV、Schedules Direct、HDHomeRun） 自带 OpenAPI 文档（/api-docs/openapi.json） 坦诚说明 项目处于持续开发阶段，尚未达到生产可用级别：转码/HLS、完整插件体系等能力还在路线图上（README 有明确边界清单）。之所以写出来，是想给同样在学"用 Rust 重写大型应用"的朋友看一份拆得很细的 workspace 组织方式，也欢迎媒体服务器同好看 API 兼容层的实现。 欢迎试用、拍砖和 PR。
projects.titleZh: 【开源自荐】jellyfin-rust：用 Rust 重写的 Jellyfin 媒体服务器，一套服务同时兼容 Jellyfin 和 Emby 两套 API

projects.titleEn: jellyfin-rust: Rust rewrite of the Jellyfin media server with Jellyfin and Emby APIs
projects.summaryEn: Rust rewrite of the Jellyfin media server serving both Jellyfin and Emby APIs over one Axum + SeaORM/PostgreSQL core. Covers auth, library scanning, playlists, images, subtitles, direct play, Live TV and TMDB/NFO metadata. Pre-production.

It uses NOAA’s NEXRAD Level II data, supports keyboard navigation, and follows your desktop theme. It’s open source and still in beta. I’m particularly interested in hearing from people who have worked with radar data, and from anyone who tries it and finds something confusing or frustrating. Happy to get into how it works.
